subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined idiom in the given sentence.**

Samuel accused Jane of __stealing the thunder__ on the capital punishment issue.

options.text: Get praise for doing something before someone

solution:
The correct answer is: **Get praise for doing something before someone**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The idiom "**stealing the thunder**" means to stop someone from getting attention or praise by doing something better than them. (किसी से कुछ बेहतर करके ध्यान या प्रशंसा पाने से रोकना)

 
 
• Example - *They all worked together on the project, but while submitting it, one of them **stole the thunder**__.*
 
 
 
• So, it is clear that the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom "**stealing the thunder**" is "**Get praise for doing something before someone**"

Hence, the correct answer is option 1.
